summary: Banco Santander filed Form 6-K to report weekly progress on its existing share buyback programme, disclosing transactions between 2–8 July 2026. Cash spent reached €3,756.8 million (74.7% of the maximum investment amount). No new programme was announced; the filing is a routine regulatory update under EU Market Abuse Regulation. There are no terms or conditions typically associated with a special situation event. The buyback was previously disclosed in February 2026, and this filing merely reports execution details.
